Variants.Content: Smolensk commanded the pivotal upper Dnieper portages linking Baltic trade to the Black Sea. Defended by deep ravines and formidable earthen-and-timber ramparts, this ancient princely seat anchored Rus defense against expanding pagan Lithuanian warlords.
Seasoned druzhina axemen guarded the grand Dormition Cathedral, upholding uninterrupted Orthodox liturgy amid border warfare.
